Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionRun a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate. The Walking Trade is a quirky, action-packed zombie apocalypse store management game where chaos and commerce collide! Design your shop, balancing space, aesthetics, and functionality. Organize shelves, set prices, and ensure customers leave happy - or at least alive. Customers aren’t your only problem - zombies invade! Wield melee weapons, firearms, or whatever you can find to defend your shop during raids and hordes. Hire survivors to scavenge supplies, serve customers, or guard the shop. Keep them equipped and motivated to reap the rewards. Unlock crafting stations to create weapons, tools, and shop upgrades. Build barricades, storage units, and even makeshift traps to keep zombies at bay. Be a benevolent shopkeeper or an opportunistic overlord. Help the community, price gouge, or even sabotage settlements for profit. Your reputation determines who comes knocking. In The Walking Trade, every decision shapes your survival. source.title: Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Mild ViolenceGamesBeyond the Dark: NightwatchReleases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalMild ViolenceLoadingFACE YOUR FEARS… TOGETHERBEYOND THE DARK: NIGHTWATCH Choose who to trust. One of you explores a strange House. The other observes through a surveillance system. Choose a role. You will need to communicate, observe and improvise to survive.Silence is death. Making noise is dangerous. THE ENTITY IS LISTENING.AN EXPERIENCE DESIGNED FOR TWO Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch is based on asymmetric cooperation: each player has a different role, tools, and information. The Explorer moves through the house, searches for clues, opens new passages, and faces danger head-on. The Overseer uses cameras, documents, utilities, and surveillance tools to understand the situation and guide their partner.Communication is key. Resolve is necessary. YOU CANNOT ESCAPE ALONE.A THRILLING INVESTIGATION Explore a mysterious house, analyze clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the strangest of places. Keep noise and disturbances to a minimum.Some dangers are visible. Some are intangible. ALL ARE DEADLY.ONLINE, USING GAMESHARE OR ON LOCAL NETWORK, INVITE SOMEONE TO JOIN YOU Designed around two screens, separate perspectives, and shared gameplay, Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch transforms the Nintendo Switch™ 2 into a unique cooperative experience. Invite your most dependable partner to experience a night of tension, coordination, trust… and perhaps panic together.Not just a game to finish. A night to remember.
